description:
Native library for numj on Windows x86-64: an x86-64-v3 (AVX2/FMA) build and an SSE2 baseline build,
    chosen at load time. Built with GCC/gfortran 16.2 (MinGW-w64), strict IEEE floating point, GCC runtime libraries
    statically linked (GCC Runtime Library Exception; see META-INF/NOTICE).
